criteria.description: Page enumerates every playlist the user owns on trigger.
criteria.evidence: test/domain/eligibility.test.ts (owned-playlist inclusion cases); test/adapters/spicetify-playlists-loader.test.ts (rootlist fixture covers owned items)

criteria.description: Page enumerates collaborative playlists the user has edit rights on.
Liked Songs is included and rendered as pinned first row, visually distinct.

criteria.evidence: test/domain/eligibility.test.ts (exclusion cases for followed, public-other, curated)

criteria.description: Each entry displays name, owner identity, track count, and cover image with placeholder fallback.
criteria.evidence: test/ui/PlaylistRow.test.tsx (name, owner, count, image+placeholder); test/ui/LikedSongsRow.test.tsx (Your Library identity)

criteria.description: Native library order preserved; Liked Songs always first.
criteria.evidence: test/domain/ordering.test.ts (native order preserved, Liked Songs pinned first)

criteria.description: Non-blocking loading indicator while fetching; no empty/broken layout.
On fetch failure, human-readable explanation plus retry affordance that re-attempts in place.
criteria.evidence: test/ui/FailedView.test.tsx (failure message + retry callback wired to store)

criteria.description: Empty eligible set surfaces a distinct empty-state message (not loading, not failure).
Hello World placeholder replaced; no longer reachable via normal navigation.
criteria.evidence: test/app.test.tsx (DedupPage mounted at sidebar entry, no Hello World render path); replacement verified at merge time when lane-a lands the new src/app.tsx
criteria.notes: src/app.tsx on the mission branch still contains the placeholder until the lane merge; FR-010 is verified post-merge by the WP09 test.

criteria.description: Idle state with explicit load-trigger affordance on page open; no host fetches before trigger.
criteria.evidence: test/ui/IdleView.test.tsx (trigger renders); test/ui/DedupPage.test.tsx (initial state is idle; no loader call on mount); test/store/playlists-store.test.ts

criteria.description: Trigger is one-shot: disappears after activation; only retry path re-initiates fetch.
criteria.evidence: test/store/playlists-store.test.ts (state machine forbids re-trigger from non-failed states); test/ui/DedupPage.test.tsx (trigger absent after activation)

criteria.description: Algorithmically efficient load: only required data fetched, no redundant requests, batching used where the host supports it.
criteria.evidence: test/adapters/spicetify-playlists-loader.test.ts (single rootlist call, no duplicate requests per playlist, batched paging asserted)

criteria.description: Up to 1,000 dedup-eligible playlists rendered without crashing, dropping entries, or producing an unrecoverable error.
criteria.evidence: test/ui/LoadedView.test.tsx (boundary case: 1000-entry fixture renders fully); test/domain/eligibility.test.ts (boundary inclusion at 1000)

criteria.description: Loading state must not block host UI; fetch and transform are asynchronous.
criteria.evidence: test/store/playlists-store.test.ts (async load path leaves main thread free); test/ui/DedupPage.test.tsx (loading state non-blocking)

criteria.description: On failure, page transitions out of loading and surfaces failure state.
criteria.evidence: test/store/playlists-store.test.ts (load failure transitions to failed); test/domain/load-state.test.ts (loading→failed transition); test/ui/FailedView.test.tsx
